image_description: An outdoor, semi-enclosed lumber processing scene featuring three men operating a portable sawmill. The structure has a corrugated metal roof supported by wooden posts. In the foreground, two men are feeding a large log into a band saw mechanism, while a third man in a hard hat observes. Background elements include stacked lumber, raw logs, and a blue pickup truck.
